newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's YPF seen making Monti CEO.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's YPF seen making Monti CEO.

text.p: Argentine oil company YPF SA shareholders Tuesday were expected to name Roberto Monti as vice president and chief executive officer, a company source said.
Monti would replace outgoing President Nells Leon as CEO. Leon will remain as a member of the board, the source told Reuters.
Monti has been president and general manager of YPF's wholly owned subsidary Maxus since 1995.
Executive vice President Miguel Madanes will likely be named president, a job that from now on will have mostly protocol responsibilities, the source said.
